name: CIS Docker Benchmark
scope: Image/build-file section only. Static Dockerfile checks are indicators; built images, daemon, host and runtime configuration are not audited.

controls.name: Use a non-root image user
controls.remediation: Define a non-root USER and verify the built image user.

controls.name: Review base-image trust
controls.summary: Base-image provenance requires a separate trust review.
controls.remediation: Verify base-image provenance and approved registry policy.

controls.name: Review unnecessary packages
controls.remediation: Remove packages not required by the application.

controls.name: Review image patching and rebuilds
controls.summary: Vulnerabilities alone cannot verify rebuild cadence or patch management.
controls.remediation: Review image advisories, patch policy and rebuild evidence.

controls.name: Review image content trust
controls.summary: Signing enforcement is not recorded by the current scanner.
controls.remediation: Verify signing and trust enforcement in the target environment.

controls.name: Declare an image health check
controls.remediation: Define a meaningful HEALTHCHECK and verify the built image.

controls.name: Combine package update and installation
controls.summary: Check package-update instructions for isolated updates.
controls.remediation: Combine package update and installation in the same build instruction.

controls.name: Review setuid and setgid permissions
controls.remediation: Review privileged executables in the built image.

controls.name: Prefer COPY over ADD
controls.remediation: Use COPY when ADD functionality is unnecessary.

controls.name: Review embedded secrets
controls.summary: The current IaC integration does not retain a complete secret assessment.
controls.remediation: Use a secret manager and review build-time secret handling.

controls.name: Review package authenticity
controls.remediation: Verify signatures and trusted package distribution.

controls.name: Review artifact signature validation
controls.remediation: Validate artifact signatures against the approved trust policy.
